description_en: Invokes the ModifyGlobalAccelerationInstanceSpec operation to modify the bandwidth of an Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用ModifyGlobalAccelerationInstanceSpec接口修改全球加速实例的带宽
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-global-acceleration-instance-spec --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --global-acceleration-instance-id ga-32s33s0000 --bandwidth 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyGlobalAccelerationInstanceSpec

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. 

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
全球加速实例所在的地域。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.name: global_acceleration_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The peak bandwidth of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例的带宽峰值，单位为Mbps，取值：10
parameters.name: bandwidth
